rule: 用户规则（2026-09-22）：机械臂操作范围内的最大圆 → 内接正方形 → 边长 × 0.8
variant: loose: every point must be reachable face-on (pitch 0) at the wall and 2.5 cm off it; tilted strokes are checked stroke by stroke by the executor instead
why_loose: v0.3 lets RL choose the pitch; requiring 30 deg everywhere would pre-empt that choice and costs ~8 cm of height (see experiments/2026-09-22_wall_cycle_v03/raw/reach)
joint_limits: V2 firmware candidates, J6 clipped to +/-180 deg; NOT calibrated (M3)
note: z is height above the base underside (world z). Re-run after M3 measures the joint limits.
